localmodel.approved_note: Stage J. On-device inference with no network and no credential. Reviewed for: network_policy 'none' with an empty egress allowlist (there is no egress to filter, so the unenforced-destination gap does not apply); no credential identity, so nothing to broker; exactly one read grant, the directory holding the endpoint socket, which is what makes a net-none sandbox able to reach a local service at all; and a single packaged bridge program under executable trust 'system'. MERGE NOTE: this provider is only usable once /usr/libexec/shadowfetch/local-model-bridge is packaged; until then readiness reports it unavailable with a reason.
